resources.string: Connect to a RelaxKonOS server. The password is used to open a session on this device and is sent nowhere else.
Server found. The preferred endpoint will be used.
Enter a host name or an HTTP(S) address, for example: host:port.
No RelaxKonOS login endpoint could be reached at this address.
%1$s is a managed host. Establish its SSH tunnel in the server centre, then sign in.
This login belongs to a managed installation with no host record on this device. Add the host in the server centre.
Save the password on this device and unlock it with the fingerprint
Save the password on this device (debug build: stored unencrypted)
No usable fingerprint or screen lock was found, so a password cannot be saved on this device.
This device has no screen lock, so a password can only be stored unencrypted here. Debug builds allow that; release builds never do.
Paste the one-time pairing code created on the Windows 10 or 11 computer. The Android device keeps its private key locally and never sends the Windows password.
Paste a pairing code from an enrolled Windows device.
This pairing code is invalid, expired, or does not name an HTTP(S) server.
This Android device is not paired with the selected server.
Pair this Android device with a Windows workstation that already has an enrolled owner device.
Pair with %1$s? The pairing code expires %2$s.
No QR pairing code was found.
Could not scan this QR code. Try a clearer image or paste the pairing code.
Manage trusted SSH hosts and their files. SSH credentials are kept separate from your server login.
No managed hosts have been added on this device.
Enter the SSH connection once. RelaxKonOS adds the host and verifies it in the same step.
Enter a valid SSH host, port, user and password.
SSH host records are managed separately from saved server logins.
Verify this SSH host-key fingerprint with the host administrator before trusting it: %1$s
The SSH host key changed. Deployment is blocked. Expected administrator confirmation is required: %1$s
Could not verify the SSH connection. Check the host, account, password and network.
Remove the local management record for %1$s? This does not uninstall RelaxKonOS, delete its data, remove saved server logins, or delete saved SSH credentials.
Enter the SSH password for this session. It stays only in memory while this page is open.
Delete %1$s and all of its contents? This cannot be undone.
This text file is larger than 1 MiB and is not opened on a phone.
This image could not be decoded.
Use a non-empty file name without a path separator.
The SSH file operation failed. Check the password, connection and trusted host key.
Connecting to the trusted SSH host…
SSH terminal disconnected. Check the connection and trusted host key.
This host did not provide a Linux resource snapshot.
Installation is not available in this Android build until the verifier and trusted release source are packaged.
Select the host platform to check saved receipts over verified SSH. Checking never repeats an installation.
Verify this SSH host again to check its operations.
Some operation records could not be checked or saved. Retry without starting a new installation.
No installation operations were found for this SSH account.
Notifications are checked while RelaxKonOS is open. Alerts remain available here when notifications are off.
System notifications are off. Alerts remain available in the app.
A server needs attention. Open RelaxKonOS to review.
Choose the same installation options as on desktop.
Choose a .zip release bundle to continue.
Choose the certificate files to continue.
Saved password · leave the field empty to sign in with the fingerprint
Saved password · leave the field empty to unlock it with the screen lock
Saved password (debug build, not encrypted) · leave the field empty to sign in with it
The saved password cannot be unlocked on this device right now. Enter the password to sign in.
The saved password is no longer valid. Enter the password and save it again to replace it.
Enter the password to sign in.
Signed in, but the password was not saved.
Signed in, but the password was not saved: %1$s
Signed in. The password was saved unencrypted, because this is a debug build and the device has no screen lock.
Enter the server address and account.
Confirm with your fingerprint to store the password for %1$s on this device.
Confirm with your fingerprint to store the administrator password on this device.
This device has no strong fingerprint sensor, so the saved password is protected by the screen lock and can be used for five minutes after you unlock the device.
Too many failed attempts. Try again later, or enter the password.
Fingerprint unlocking is locked. Unlock the device with its screen lock, then try again.
The saved password can no longer be unlocked because the device fingerprints changed. It stays on this device until you delete it; sign in with the password and save it again to replace it.
Fingerprint unlocking is not available on this device right now. The saved password is not affected.
The saved password could not be verified. It stays on this device; enter the password and save it again to replace it.
Save the administrator password on this device
Saving an administrator password needs a strong fingerprint sensor, so it is unavailable on this device.
Enter the administrator account and password.
The administrator password was not saved. Press Authorize again to continue without saving it.
Could not reach the server. Check the network and the server address.
The account or password is incorrect.
Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
This account may not sign in from here.
This operation needs the administrator password.
This operation needs the administrator password.
The administrator password was rejected. The saved one has been deleted.
That account is not an administrator on this server.
Host metrics are not ready yet.
The session expired. Sign in again.

This host account cannot be used for ordinary file, terminal, or Git operations: root, system accounts below UID 1000, nobody, and accounts without a usable home directory are outside what this server allows. Sign in with a regular host account instead.
File operations are available through the privileged Helper. Ordinary terminal and Git operations are unavailable for this account.

The server cannot run ordinary operations as this host account right now: in User Mode it runs only as its own host account, and any other deployment needs the privileged helper installed and running.
This server does not offer that feature.
No server has been saved yet.

Delete the password saved for %1$s (%2$s)? The connection stays, and the password will have to be typed again.
Delete the saved login for %1$s (%2$s) together with the password stored for it?

Open a folder to upload into.
Could not save to this device.

This device has no room to prepare the file.
The file changed while it was being sent. Start again.
The selected file can no longer be read. Pick it again.
This folder needs an administrator password.
The server cannot use this file name. Rename the file and try again.
The upload session was refused. Sign in again and retry.
This file could not be shown as an image.
Reading this file needs an administrator password.
Select a file or folder to see its properties.
The server did not return properties for this entry.
No deployment or publishing operations were found for this account.
Tasks could not be refreshed. The last result is unknown.
Check the target resource before trying again. This task will not run automatically.
Cancellation is a request. Refresh the remote record to confirm the final result.
Review this report before saving. Diagnostic output may contain secrets. The time range is when this device first observed and last verified the operation, not the server log range.
Could not save the diagnostic report
This removes the task from this account’s list on this device. The server operation and its resources are unaffected.
Alerts are read from the server when this page is open. Acknowledging one does not resolve the fault.
The alert action could not be confirmed.
Select a section on the left.
No reading has been taken yet.
The last reading is out of date (%1$s).
History is not available yet: this server exposes a single reading, not a time series.
Terminate immediately instead of asking it to stop
Select a section on the left.
Fingerprint switch, saved passwords, device capability
Connection self-check and a redacted report
Sign out of this server? The saved connection and its password stay on this device.
Save passwords on this device and unlock them with a fingerprint.
Every saved password will be deleted from this device and its unlock keys destroyed. Saved connections stay.
Strong fingerprint, confirmed for every use
Screen lock, valid for five minutes after unlocking the device
This device authenticator is weaker than a strong fingerprint, so a host administrator password is not offered here.
Not available on this device, which needs a strong fingerprint
An administrator password is deleted as soon as the server rejects it, and it is never used for anything other than the operation you authorized.
Delete every saved password from this device? Saved connections stay, and you will have to type the passwords again.
No longer valid: the device fingerprints changed. Delete it, and save the password again if you still need it.
Saved unencrypted: debug build, and this device has no screen lock.
Delete the saved password for %1$s on %2$s?

Changing the language restarts the screen. You stay signed in and saved passwords are untouched. Following the system uses Chinese or Japanese when the device is set to either, and English for every other language.
The self-check has not been run yet.
Host metrics: refused by the server
File roots: refused by the server
The report contains server addresses, capability names, record counts and the self-check result. It never contains a password, a token or stored ciphertext.
Stored records: %1$d server password(s) and %2$d administrator password(s).
RelaxKonOS includes third-party components. Their notices are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the repository root.
Inspect applications, runtime and recent operations
Read-only access in this version. Creation and lifecycle actions are not yet available.
Docker Engine is reachable. This does not confirm deployment permission, disk space or port availability.
Docker capability is unavailable on this server. Check the server mode and host configuration.
Docker is not installed. Ask the host administrator to install a supported Engine.
Docker cannot be reached. Check the Engine service and its host permissions.
The server cannot access Docker. Ask the host administrator to check Docker permissions.
The Docker response is incompatible. Check the installed Engine version.
This account cannot read application deployments. Use an authorized account.
This application no longer exists. Return to the list and refresh.
Deployment records are unavailable. Check server storage and retry.
This platform is unsupported for application deployment.
Unable to verify the current result. Reconnect and refresh.
No applications have been created on this server.
Select an application to inspect its current state.
Runtime drift needs attention. Check the container and deployment records on the server.
The operation left resources requiring attention. Inspect the server before retrying.
Container images and Java, .NET and Python archives are supported. The server validates every deployment before it runs.
HTTP readiness requires a host port reachable through the configured bind address.
A site requires a host port. Leave empty to skip proxy integration.
Use an explicit image tag or digest.
A new deployment replaces the running revision and may briefly interrupt service.
Image tags unavailable; enter a versioned reference manually.
3–40 characters. Start with a letter or digit; use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores thereafter.
Choose a server-supported source. Deployment stays bound to loopback; the server validates the source, ports, access and available resources.
This folder has no .zip or .jar archives.
The selected archive streams directly to server-owned staging. It is not retained in the application definition.
Roll back to revision %1$d? The service may be briefly unavailable. Application data volumes are not rolled back.
Remove this application? Its managed data volumes will be retained.
No log lines are currently available.
Logs are loaded only when requested.
Templates are verified by the server. Secret fields are never added to a draft or summary.
This template uses a schema this app does not support.
The template source has not been verified by the server.
This template has been withdrawn and cannot be installed.
This server does not provide every capability required by this template.
The container runtime is unavailable, so compatibility cannot be checked.
This template does not support this server\'s operating system or architecture.
This template contains a field type or default this app cannot safely use.
Inspect containers and deploy supported Compose stacks.
Docker is unavailable on this server.
Could not load this resource list.
Remove container %1$s? Its persistent data is not deleted.
Remove stack %1$s? Named volumes are retained.
The Docker operation could not be completed.
Could not read the selected Compose document.
Only image services, named volumes and project-managed networks are supported. Build contexts, bind mounts, external files, privileged services and Docker socket access are rejected by the server.
Enter a stack name and a Compose document.
Parsed %1$d service(s), %2$d volume(s) and %3$d network(s). Nothing has been applied.
Submitted. The server runs this operation and records its result.
This project has no recorded operations.
The operation on %1$s finished, but some services did not reach their target state.
The operation on %1$s was interrupted by a server restart. The actual services were inspected; nothing was replayed.
The operation on %1$s is still running on the server.
Delete volume %1$s? Its data cannot be recovered.
Your account may not change Docker resources on this server.
This resource no longer exists on the server. Refresh the list.
The project name is not valid. Use letters, digits, \'-\' and \'_\', up to 63 characters.
The Compose document could not be parsed. Check the YAML and try again.
This Compose document uses a feature this server does not deploy from a phone: build, bind mount, external resource, privileged mode, or Docker socket access.
This Compose document references variables, and this server has no way to supply their values. Write the concrete values into the document (use $$ for a literal dollar sign).
The definition changed after it was previewed. Preview it again and deploy the version you actually reviewed.
This action needs an explicit confirmation.
This project already has an operation in progress. Wait for it to finish.
The submission was refused because it carried no usable idempotency key. Retry the action.
This request was already submitted with different content. Retry the action to start a new operation.
The operation can no longer be cancelled; it has already reached an outcome.
The operation ledger is unavailable on the server, so the change was not queued.
The Docker engine could not complete this command. Check the runtime status and the operation output.
Inspect sites, TLS and host publication diagnostics.
This view only observes host configuration. It cannot prove public DNS propagation or internet reachability.
Publishing creates a managed HTTPS proxy only after you confirm the domain, public reachability, and any required administrator approval. DNS credentials are never requested here.
Choose a running loopback application and a managed web server. The host tests and reloads its own configuration.
No managed certificate matches this domain; request a new one instead.
I accept the certificate authority terms.
I confirm this domain reaches this host publicly on HTTP port 80.
The phone could not read the publication operation. It continues on the host and can be recovered by refreshing.
No supported, managed web server was reported by this host.
The host could not provide website diagnostics. Refresh after checking the server connection and permission.
Host web server is not running.
The host web-server runtime state could not be verified.
The host configuration passed its syntax check.
The host configuration did not pass its syntax check.
The host configuration could not be checked.
This web server does not support configuration checks through this connection.
No RelaxKonOS-owned sites are configured on this web server.
The site list could not be read. This does not prove that a site is absent.
No managed application is associated with this site.
The managed application association could not be verified through this connection.
TLS is not enabled for this site.
TLS is enabled, but its certificate association could not be verified through this connection.
Small text edits and repository status
Only existing UTF-8 files up to 256 KiB can be edited. Saving, committing, pushing, and deploying are separate actions. This screen does not deploy.
The server file changed. Your draft is kept in memory. Reopen the file to compare or copy your changes before saving.
Difference between the latest server file and your draft
No repositories are registered for this account.
The repository must already exist on the server. This does not clone a remote URL.
Resolve conflicts before committing or pushing: %1$s
The draft stays in memory. Secret files are never saved as phone drafts.
File saved. Commit separately to include it in a deployment.
Commit only this file. Push is separate; remote builds require the commit on the remote.
The Ubuntu server resolves an HTTPS branch or tag to a commit, then builds it in a configured limited BuildKit builder. Only remote commits can be built.
Choose an image application or create one. Publishing starts a separate deployment operation.
Terminal connection failed. The remote session may still be running.
The previous session is no longer on the Server.

Changing to another account requires fresh host administrator approval.

The last start or health check failed.
The configured host account changed identity. Review Run as before starting.
The host could not start this workload as the selected account.
The executable, working directory or health check is invalid.
